0.label: left_rim_nested_squares
0.description: The left side of the drawn tray: two nested-square cartouches, each with a diagonal mark inside, separated by a cross-hatched panel and bands of combing.
0.iconography: Nested squares with a diagonal read like signs rather than pictures — comparable to textile and àrokò geometry. Mirrored on the right side (#2).

1.label: bottom_rim_triangle_chain
1.description: The lower edge: a chain of about eight hatched triangles pointing alternately, ending in a bow-tie of two triangles.
1.iconography: A sawtooth chain at the foot of the tray. Its fixed count of units makes it a small test case for 'pattern as number'.

2.label: right_rim_nested_squares
2.description: The right side: nested-square cartouches with diagonals and a cross-hatched panel, mirroring the left side (#0).

3.label: pencil_shading_margin
3.description: A box over the lower-right corner of the drawing and the blank paper beside it, holding only faint pencil dots.
3.iconography: Not carving — paper and pencil. No meaning.

panel.title: Survey drawing of a small Ifá tray (26.5 × 33 cm): nested squares and a triangle chain
panel.object_type: pen-and-ink survey drawing of a rectangular opon Ifá
panel.summary: A drawing captioned 'Ifabrett 26.5 × 33 cm, Yoruba 3' of a small tray with an entirely geometric border: a face at the top centre, nested-square cartouches and cross-hatching down both sides, and a chain of triangles along the foot.

register_readings.reading: Top (undetected): a small face between hatched blocks.
Sides: nested squares with diagonals and cross-hatched panels, mirrored.
Foot: the triangle chain; #3 is blank paper.

panel.composition: A symmetrical, fully geometric frame with a single face on the axis.
panel.narrative: The most sign-like tray in the collection: apart from the face, its border is made of repeated geometric units — nested squares, cross-hatch, triangles — closer to textile pattern than to pictures. If any tray encodes a count or a sequence in pattern, this is a good one to test.
panel.hypotheses: Neutral for 'chronicle'. Best candidate among the trays for 'pattern as number' (countable units on each side), though untested.
cross_panel_links: Nested squares and triangle chains also frame the plank EBA-Div_00311_panel_02.
uncertainties: #3 is not carving; the face is undetected.
